I've gathered all the information about Alberto Carbonell. Here's a summary:

**Profile:**
- **Name:** Alberto Carbonell
- **Title:** Senior Software Engineer — AI Agents & Full-Stack TypeScript
- **Location:** Spain · Remote
- **Tagline:** Senior engineer, 10+ years with TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. I build AI agents that do real work end to end.

**Experience:**
- **CoverWallet (2019–now):** Senior Software Engineer in Madrid/Remote, working on an insurtech platform integrating insurance carriers. Highlights include leading cross-team projects, integrating third-party APIs, introducing AI agents into engineering workflow, and mentoring new hires. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, Ruby on Rails.
- **M&GT Consulting (2016–2019):** Software Developer in Madrid, building REST APIs and web/mobile apps for international clients, plus blockchain solutions on Hyperledger Fabric and Ethereum. Stack: Node.js, REST, iOS, Android, Hyperledger Fabric, Ethereum.
- **Indra (2015–2016):** Software Developer in A Coruña, working with Java/Spring and Oracle PL/SQL for telecom clients, plus QA and hotfixes. Stack: Java, Spring, Oracle PL/SQL.

**Tech Stack:**
- **AI/agents:** Claude, Grok, Open-source models (via Ollama), Tool calling, MCP, Agent evals and monitoring
- **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript, Ruby
- **Backend & data:** Node.js, NestJS, Express, Next.js, REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- **Infra:** Docker, Kubernetes, CircleCI, Vercel, Railway, Neon, GCP
- **Frontend:** React, React Native, Angular

**Projects:**
- **Fraud Detection Agent (deployed):** Reviews events and organizers on a ticketing platform, recommending approve/reject/request-info with reasons. Achieved 92% accuracy vs 68% baseline, 0% fraud approved without human review, fewer escalations, ~$0.002 per review.
- **Organizer Support Agent (coming soon):** Answers organizers' questions about sales, payouts and setup autonomously, using live data from PostgreSQL and payments API.
- **Portfolio Agent (personal project):** Answers visitors' questions about his experience and projects in natural language; also exposed as an MCP server for external agents to query.

**Education:** Higher Technical Diplomas (CFGS) in Web Development, Multiplatform Development and Systems Administration at CIFP Rodolfo Ucha Piñeiro (2010–2015).

**Languages:** Spanish (native), English (C1).
